# Dashboard Builder

Curated by Skill Harbor: a workflow skill for building dashboards people can actually operate from, on Grafana, SigNoz, and similar platforms. Its founding rule: never start from visual layout, start from operator questions (is it healthy, where is the bottleneck, what changed, what action should someone take). You define the questions first, study the platform's schema and query language, then build the minimum useful board: overview, then health, latency, throughput, and saturation sections, with titled panels, units, and sane thresholds. Guardrails included: no metric dumps, no mixing concerns without structure, no untitled panels. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance, nothing to install; you need access to a dashboard platform and real metrics; examples assume Grafana-style JSON dashboards. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
